title: komit
desc: A CLI tool that stages your changes, asks a Groq-hosted LLM to write a Conventional Commits message from the diff, and pushes. No dependencies beyond the Python standard library.

title: Backstory
desc: A personal app for logging the movies and shows I've watched, and keeping a list of what I want to watch next. Deployed via Vercel. Invite-only for now, reach out if you'd like access.
